name: cmsisdap-bl702-probe
experiment:
# CMSIS-DAP v2 (bulk) probe, REAL hardware: an XT-ZB1 / BL702 board running
# CherryUSB BL702-DAPLink (USB d6e7:3507, "RV CMSIS-DAP"), through the native
# Go stack: Linux usbfs -> CMSIS-DAP v2 -> generic SWD/ADIv5 -> Cortex-M.
# No OpenOCD, probe-rs, libusb, Python or CGO.
#
# NO TARGET WAS WIRED to the probe when this was recorded, so the recording
# proves the probe itself (descriptor-selected DAP interface, DAP_Info and
# capabilities, SWJ clock acceptance, JTAG chain scan of an empty chain, read
# only DAP_SWJ_Pins) and that every target operation fails explicitly instead
# of succeeding. It never writes memory, flash or the target's reset line.
#
#   hwlab devices                                  # cmsisdap/d6e7:3507:<serial>
#   hwlab run --yes examples/cmsisdap-bl702-probe.yaml
#
# Wire a target (3.3 V logic only, common GND):
#   SWD : SWDIO = BL702 GPIO2, SWCLK = BL702 GPIO15, nRESET = BL702 GPIO24
#   JTAG: TDI = GPIO0, TDO = GPIO1, TMS = GPIO2, TCK = GPIO15
name: cmsisdap-bl702-probe
duration: 12s

devices:
  dbg:
    plugin: cmsisdap

steps:
  - {name: info,        at: 100ms, device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.info}
  - {name: pins,        at: 500ms, device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.pins}
  - {name: clock-probe, at: 1s,    device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.clock_probe, args: {rates_hz: [100000, 400000, 1000000, 2000000, 4000000]}}
  - {name: jtag-scan,   at: 2s,    device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.jtag_scan}
  - {name: connect,     at: 3s,    device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.connect, args: {clock_hz: 100000}}
  - {name: read,        at: 4s,    device: dbg, call: MemoryAccess.read, args: {address: "0x20000000", length: 16}}
  - {name: status,      at: 5s,    device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.status}
  - {name: info-final,  at: 6s,    device: dbg, call: DebugProbe.info}
